# Laws of one step at coarser steps

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Balance (each relatum listed once), dissipation and running down (what stands held at both ends) compose over a coarse step, closure exactly, so one exchange's law and the exact conditions of coming and ceasing to stand hold there. Not conversely; only active giving and taking are step-relative.

`laws-at-coarser-steps` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Read a world at strictly increasing times σ, each coarse step being the fine steps from σ s to just before σ (s + 1) (Strict, span). Each condition is stated at one coarse step, with hypotheses on the fine steps inside it only. What composes: balance on a family composes where each relatum is listed once at the fine steps inside (Flow.BalancesOn.sample, through balance_over_stretch_on, Flow.sample_taken_on, Flow.sample_given_on); dissipation on a family composes unconditionally (Flow.DissipatesOn.sample); a family is closed across the coarse step exactly when it is closed across each fine step inside (Flow.sample_closedAt_iff); running down composes where the family holds what stands at the two coarse ends only (Flow.RunsDownOn.sample), and running down at every fine step gives it at the coarse step (Flow.RunsDownOn.sample_of_fine). So at the coarse step some standing changes exactly when the family's total at the end is below its total at the start (Flow.sample_changes_iff); with balance at the fine steps a condition comes to stand across the coarse step exactly when it stood at nothing and the fine steps gave it more than they took, and ceases to stand exactly when it stood and they took all it had with all they gave (Flow.sample_comesToStand_iff, Flow.sample_ceasesToStand_iff). The web read at the times σ (Web.sample) states activity needing support, embodiment and a census of the sampled fine step (Web.sample_dependent, sample_embodied, sample_census, sample_standingCensus); with activity decided, arising or ceasing across a coarse step is arising or ceasing across a fine step inside it (Web.sample_arises, Web.sample_ceases). The global readings are corollaries (Flow.sample_balances, Flow.sample_dissipative, World.sample_survives, and World.sample_rests_unrefuted, with no decision procedure).

Canonical source: [Sampling.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Sampling.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- No global premise: the condition of each law is stated inside it, on the fine steps inside the coarse step only.
- The reading: strictly increasing times (Strict); the fine steps between samples are taken as given, with no refinement below them. Balance composes where each relatum is listed once at the fine steps inside (the coarse tally counts a relatum once, the fine tallies as often as it is listed).

The zero-premise plan lists discrete steps as a commitment of the representation (Ren's item 4: time); Ren set on 11 October to do coarser steps first, then continuous time. This result tests that commitment and adds no premise: it asks whether the local conditions of Becoming.Locality at a coarse step compose from those at the fine steps inside it. The laws hold of every world, so of a world read at coarser steps; what has to be shown is whether their conditions compose.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 90 theorems of the new core module Becoming.Sampling all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. It was first compiled from the prelude in a scratch tree, with no warnings and every #print axioms empty. The core closure is 49 modules, every source declaration in it with an empty axiom report, compiling from Lean's prelude alone. There is no independent review yet; the author's counterreview is in §80 of the integration note.

The converse does not compose: balance and dissipation at the coarse step do not give them at the fine steps (Cancelling.coarse_not_fine, Averaging.coarse_not_fine). Only active relata giving and only active relata taking are step-relative (Strobe.acting_taking_step_relative), composing only where activity holds over the interval (Flow.sample_acting_on, sample_taking_on, Web.held_of_unit, Web.held_of_constant); bounded transmission of dependences is step-relative too (Delay.transmitting_step_relative). Recurring at the coarse steps is recurring at the fine ones, not conversely (Strobe.converse_fails). Not shown: real-valued time (beyond the tower of discrete readings); whether a becoming given with no step can be represented by discrete steps; whether listing once can be dropped for balance. This is a reading at a coarser step, not a refinement of the unit of amounts (Becoming.Resolution). No premise is derived. The names (Strict, span, sample, Held and others) are the AI's.

- Cancelling and Averaging: balance and dissipation hold at the coarse step but not at the fine ones (fine imbalances cancel; a fine step giving without loss is outweighed by a later one). [Sampling.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Sampling.lean)
- Strobe: a relatum active at the second fine step of each coarse step gives and takes there and is off at both sampling times; only active relata giving and taking fail at the coarse step, and arising and ceasing recur at the fine steps while the coarse steps are quiet. Delay: a gift made inside a coarse step before the receiver comes to stand is read as a descent across the coarse step. [Sampling.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Sampling.lean)

**Output:** Balance, dissipation and running down on a family across one step, with their exact laws.

**Input:** These conditions stated at a coarse step, composed from those at the fine steps inside it, so the laws hold at the coarse step.

**Preserved conditions:** Balance asks each relatum to be listed once. [Locality.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Locality.lean)


**Output:** A count balanced across each step of a stretch is balanced over the stretch, nothing asked outside it.

**Input:** Balance at a coarse step is the sum of balance at the fine steps inside it.

**Preserved conditions:** None. [Change.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Change.lean)


**Output:** The premises of a world.

**Input:** In a world read at coarser steps the premises are stated of the sampled fine steps (World.sample_survives).

**Preserved conditions:** Balance asks listing once. [Premises.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Premises.lean)
